content.title: Bath & Body Works Stock Tanked After Earnings. Directors Bought Up Shares.
content.summary: Bath & Body Works  stock tanked following the release of third-quarter numbers, compounding an already grim year for the retailer.  Six company directors recently bought up shares.  Shares plunged 25% on Nov. 20 to $15.82, their largest single-day percentage drop in over five years, after the retailer missed earnings projections and cut its fiscal-year forecast.

content.title: Signet Jewelers CEO talks lab-grown vs. natural diamonds
content.description:
Lab-grown diamonds have become more popular, especially with younger consumers.

J.K. Symancyk, CEO of Signet Jewelers (SIG) (Kay Jewelers and Zales' parent company), joins Market Catalysts host Julie Hyman and Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi to discuss the growing trend and how the company is addressing customers seeking both lab-grown and natural options.

To watch more expert insights and analysis on the latest market action, check out more Market Catalysts.
